items.title: James Chirillo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: Keter, who I played with plenty over the last few years until he just passed away like a year ago.

ctx.x: Barefield. I mean he got an idea, I mean I heard Zoot Sims, Zoot Sims came down and did “Spoleto.” When they had a Spoleto Festival in Charleston, South Carolina in the late seventies for a couple of years and they brought the North Texas band out there. So we’d back up whoever they would bring in. And they never would bring in guitar players. So the whole North Texas rhythm section had to take a break, but I got to play with, I mean we did a couple of nights with Ella so I got to play with Tommy Flanagan and…
